title: Vectors: SCHC test vectors
description: Complete test/vectors/schc-*.json. Cover: rules 1-6, fragmentation, reassembly, ACK encoding. Include edge cases. All three implementations must pass.
close_reason: Coverage already complete: test/vectors/schc_compression.json has byte-exact round-trips for rules 0-6 (and 7/255), fallbacks, truncated residues, padding, and profile-size edges. test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json covers ACK-on-Error fragmentation, reassembly, ACK/ACK-REQ/abort encoding, window transition, recovery, retry exhaustion, capacity, and malformed wires with independent CRC-32/SHA-256 oracles. Python test_vectors.py and rust/lichen-schc/tests/shared_vectors.rs plus fragmentation_vectors.rs pass. No vector gaps to fill.
